intent: Evidence-first synthesis answering a stated research question.

evidence_burden.rationale: A research piece that never met a source disagreeing with it has not finished its research.

flexibility: Structure is a default, not a requirement. Sections may be merged or renamed when the argument calls for it; the evidence burden may not be relaxed.
anti_patterns: Sequential restatement of each source in turn
A literature-review shape with no synthesis of our own
Historical analogues invoked for colour rather than examined
Scenarios presented with the same confidence as findings

quality_gates.rationale: Highest floor: a research piece argues from material and should show it.
